# v0.4.0 validation record

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

This record covers the retained local v0.4.0 checkpoint. No upload, deployment, or
external publication was made.

## Contract evidence

* Randomized replacement tests perform 2,000 comparison transitions and reject every
  retired job publication. Ten thousand synchronous cancellations complete within the
  25 ms release limit.
* Dataset generation tests distinguish dataset-load publication from service to later
  comparison generations. The matching cross-browser scenario covers feature-track
  computation after navigation and successive comparison request IDs.
* Annotation parsing checks its abort signal at stream boundaries, yields every 16
  chunks, cancels the reader, and suppresses terminal publication. The cancellation
  test aborts at first progress and observes no completion or error.
* Cross-layer tests exercise every active fallback and fit representative haploid and
  diploid human envelopes within the 4 GiB total. Actual chromosome-scale navigation
  traces remain covered by the retained v0.2 evidence; robust billion-base operation
  on ordinary laptops is still conditional.
* Predicted frozen-axis memory is asserted to cover observed retained heap use. FASTA
  input is handed off in 4 MiB shards and progressive axis work yields in bounded bins.
* The one-million-record BED test parsed and cloned 1,000,000 features in 1,399 ms,
  including a 970 ms structured clone. Estimated retained storage was 176,000,000
  bytes, below the 256 MiB retained and transient-publication limits.
